seoTitle: How to Fix Product Not Showing on Shopify (5 Ways)
metaDescription: Fix products that aren't appearing on your Shopify store with 5 solutions covering publishing status, sales channels, and collections.
intro: A product that won't show up on your storefront can quietly cost you sales until you catch it. This guide walks through five common reasons Shopify products go missing and how to fix each one, from publishing status to collection and inventory issues.

steps.heading: Check if the product is published
steps.body: Confirm the product's status is set to active and published rather than left as a draft.

steps.heading: Verify it's assigned to the right sales channel
steps.body: Make sure the product is added to your Online Store sales channel, since products can be created without being assigned there.

steps.heading: Confirm it's included in the collection
steps.body: Check that the product is manually added or matches the rules for the collection where you expect it to appear.

steps.heading: Review inventory and stock settings
steps.body: If the product is out of stock and set to hide when unavailable, it won't display until inventory is restocked.

steps.heading: Check theme or settings errors
steps.body: Look for theme-level filters or settings that might be excluding the product from view, and adjust them as needed.

faq.question: Why does a product show in admin but not on my storefront?
faq.answer: This usually means the product isn't published to the Online Store sales channel, even though it exists in your product list.

faq.question: Can out-of-stock products still show on my store?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have Shopify configured to continue selling out-of-stock items, but if that setting is off, the product may be hidden until restocked.

faq.question: Do collection rules affect product visibility?
faq.answer: Yes, if a product doesn't match a collection's automated rules or isn't manually added, it won't appear in that collection even if it's published.

faq.question: How long does it take for a newly published product to appear?
faq.answer: Published products usually appear almost immediately, though caching on your theme or CDN can occasionally cause a short delay.
